# Changelog

This page records notable changes to the Boundary User Guide.

## 2026-11

- Added field guidance to Transparent sessions on Client Agent packaging and versioning, client cache tuning, and common issues with virtual private network (VPN) and endpoint security software.
- Added a note to the Introduction that a client can only hold a login to one Boundary control plane at a time.

## 2026-08

- Restructured legacy Boundary HVD content into the HVD 2.0 Boundary User Guide as part of the Installation / Administration / User guide migration.
